I'm reading this as requiring **410 Gone**, not 404.

An expired short link once existed but is now deliberately unavailable; 410 semantically fits that better than 404 (which suggests it never existed). They behave differently to caches and clients, and 410 is the more informative choice.

```json
{
  "cites": "PRD-2.4",
  "ambiguity": "requires not returning the original URL, but does not specify which status code to return for an expired link",
  "assumed": "410 Gone — the link existed and was deliberately expired, not 404 Not Found"
}
```
